Class AmwpConstants

java.lang.Object
org.aetheris.wire.AmwpConstants
public final class AmwpConstants extends Object
The AmwpConstants class holds the numbers for an AMWP frame. AMWP is the framed protocol on the connection. A multi-byte integer is little-endian. The first header byte is the magic value 0xAE. The header is 16 bytes. The payload cap is 1 mebibyte. // @aa-sdd G-07 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md
